title: Family-wise error as a named any-mistake contract
dek: FWER = P(V≥1). Wikipedia error-rate node. Stricter than FDR; sometimes that is the point.
story: Family-wise error rate on Wikipedia is P(at least one false rejection in the family). It is a probability of any mistake, not an expected fraction among hits.

Confirmatory families (a pre-specified list of primary endpoints, a small set of resistance genes you will act on clinically) often want FWER. Exploratory RNA-seq mountains often want FDR. Name which.
Holm, Šidák, Bonferroni, closed testing, and maxT permutation are recipes. The contract is this node.
deep: If you redefine the family after seeing the data, FWER control is theatre.
Dependence: permutation of labels (or a phylogeny-aware null) can control FWER without paying Bonferroni's full union bound.
False coverage rate is a selective-inference cousin for intervals.
Do not report FWER as q-values.

visual.caption: FWER cares whether V is ever positive. FDR cares about the ratio V/R when R>0. Different functionals of the same (V,R).
visual.reference: name the loss before the recipe
